charm.how: Catch every Pokémon in the National Pokédex (Mythicals not needed), then talk to the Game Director at Hotel Grand Lake on Route 213. In this game it only helps eggs.
charm.note: Game8; Serebii; Kaphotics: 'Shiny Charm is not checked anywhere else in the game code, besides eggs.'

methods.name: Random encounters
methods.plain: Any Pokémon you meet has a 1 in 4,096 chance to be shiny.
methods.detail: One try per Pokémon. The Shiny Charm doesn't help wild Pokémon in this game.
methods.note: Kaphotics (datamine): the charm is only checked for eggs

methods.name: Masuda Method
methods.plain: Breed two Pokémon whose games are in different languages: the eggs have a much better shiny chance.
methods.detail: 6 tries per egg, 8 with the Shiny Charm.

methods.name: Breeding (same-language parents)
methods.plain: Ordinary eggs have the normal shiny chance; the Shiny Charm helps them too.
methods.detail: 1 try, 2 with the Shiny Charm. Quirk: with the charm but no Masuda Method an egg gets 2 tries, not 3, because the egg code skips the normal first try.
methods.note: Kaphotics; same egg code as Sword / Shield (Admiral-Fish)

methods.name: Poké Radar chain
methods.plain: Chain the same Pokémon with the Poké Radar: from a chain of 40, each shaking patch is about 1 in 99 to be shiny, with up to 4 patches each time.
methods.detail: Only shaking patches get the boost and the Shiny Charm doesn't apply. Mid-chain values are rounded.
methods.note: Chain 40 and 39 from several sources; the mid-chain values (10, 20, 30) only from RotomLabs [single]

methods.name: Grand Underground hideaways
methods.plain: Pokémon in Grand Underground hideaways are 1 in 4,096. Digging up enough Diglett for the bonus gives about 1 in 2,048 for a few minutes.
methods.detail: The Diglett bonus (40 points) adds a try; re-enter a hideaway after it starts. Outlets disagree on 2 or 3 tries, so the rounded 2-try figure is given. The Shiny Charm doesn't help.
methods.note: RotomLabs; outlets disagree on 2 vs 3 rolls for the Diglett bonus; no datamine found
